description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the canonical AI-source regex covering all 18+ patterns including non-obvious ones like `doubao.com`, `chat.qwen.ai`, `edgeservices.bing.com`, bare `openai`, and bare `perplexity` tokens. (2) Create `channel_group_ai.json` with a proper GA4 channel group structure containing an 'AI Chatbots' channel using the canonical regex — and critically, the 'AI Chatbots' channel must appear BEFORE the 'Referral' channel in the channels array (the ordering trap from SKILL.md: 'Place AI Chatbots above Referral so it matches first'). (3) Use the same regex to classify sessions from the CSV, counting AI vs non-AI sessions and listing detected AI source domains, then write this to `ai_traffic_summary.json`. An agent relying on general knowledge will likely miss the ordering constraint, omit obscure AI sources like doubao.com/chat.qwen.ai/edgeservices.bing.com, and miss the bare 'openai'/'perplexity' tokens that GA4 sometimes reports.
